title: How to Properly Recycle Glass Containers
steps: Collect glass containers like jars and bottles used for food and beverages.
Rinse thoroughly to remove food residue or liquids.
Remove lids or caps as some recycling centers ask for them separately.
Sort by color if required (e.g., clear, brown, green) for better recycling.
Place clean glass containers in the designated glass recycling bin or take to a recycling center.
Encourage reuse where possible before recycling.
Spread awareness about the importance of glass recycling.
precautions: Do not throw broken glass into regular recycling bins to avoid injury.
Avoid mixing glass with non-recyclable items.
Do not throw glass containers in landfill if recycling options are available.
Store glass safely to prevent breakage before disposal.
